latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Labor and Human Resources.

summaries.text: Improved Patient Access to Clinical Studies Act of 1996 - Prohibits a health plan from denying, limiting, imposing additional conditions on, or discriminating against an enrollee on the basis of the enrollee's participation in an approved clinical study.
